description:
Follow-up to closed JMAP-wrgs.1. The field crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/notification.rs:99 is currently:

    /// A PatchObject encoding the change between `event` and the state
    /// after the update.
    pub event_patch: Option<serde_json::Value>,

Doc says 'a PatchObject'; type is Value. This is a notification *payload* field (server → client), not an *update argument* (client → server), which is why the closed PatchObject adoption epic JMAP-wrgs.1 did not migrate it. The PatchObject typing is still spec-correct — it is just read-only on this side.

Proposed change (jmap-calendars-types/src/notification.rs:99):

    pub event_patch: Option<jmap_types::PatchObject>,

Wire format unchanged (PatchObject is #[serde(transparent)]). Public API change: any caller pattern-matching on the field type or constructing CalendarEventNotification from a Value literal must migrate.

PLAN.md (crate-jmap-calendars-types/PLAN.md §2) currently does NOT justify this field as Sloppy-Value (§2 covers recurrence_overrides nested PatchObject values; that is a different rationale than this top-level field). So either:
  - Migrate to PatchObject (this bead's recommendation, matches the field's documented contract), OR
  - Leave as Value AND add a PLAN.md note explaining why.

## Scope

- 1 line change + import in jmap-calendars-types/src/notification.rs.
- Tests/fixtures: any test that constructs CalendarEventNotification via serde_json::from_value will keep working unchanged. Direct struct-literal constructions (if any) need a 'PatchObject::from_map(...)' wrapper.

## Acceptance criteria

'cargo test --workspace' clean, lib clippy clean, wire format byte-identical, PLAN.md updated to reference the typed field.

## Coordination

Public API change to a non-locked crate but sets precedent for the LOCKED jmap-mail-types and jmap-tasks-types parallel fields (JMAP-6h5s follow-up bead, and the equivalent in tasks).
notes: Re-opened 2026-05-09 after the wider-scope survey identified 5 additional sibling fields. Now a child of parent epic JMAP-trmz. See epic for full sweep context.
title: Migrate CalendarEventNotification::event_patch to typed PatchObject
